stage: 同日直接链接计划及三源回执
executed_source:
from pathlib import Path
from urllib.parse import urljoin,urlparse
from datetime import datetime
from zoneinfo import ZoneInfo
import requests,json,hashlib
root=Path.cwd(); out=root/'reports/research/510300_treasury_soma_all_revision_prior_policy_sources_v1'
links=json.loads((out/'20220504原声明直接链接.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8-sig'))
matches=[r for r in links if r['text']=="Plans for Reducing the Size of the Federal Reserve's Balance Sheet" and r['href']=='/newsevents/pressreleases/monetary20220504b.htm']
assert len(matches)==1, '原声明未唯一直接链接固定计划，不能推定来源'
url=urljoin('https://www.federalreserve.gov',matches[0]['href'])
target=out/'sources/20220504_资产负债表缩减原计划.html'; assert not target.exists()
attempts=[]; receipt={'source_id':'fed20220504_balance_sheet_plan','url':url,'direct_link_evidence':'20220504原声明直接链接.json','started_at':datetime.now(ZoneInfo('Asia/Shanghai')).isoformat(),'historic_receipt':False}
for attempt in range(1,3):
 try:
  r=requests.get(url,timeout=(15,35),headers={'User-Agent':'Mozilla/5.0 (historical research; limited requests)'})
  attempts.append({'attempt':attempt,'http_status':r.status_code,'final_url':r.url})
  if r.status_code in [403,429]: break
  r.raise_for_status(); assert urlparse(r.url).hostname=='www.federalreserve.gov'
  raw=r.content; assert b'<html' in raw.lower() and len(raw)>1000
  with target.open('xb') as h: h.write(raw)
  receipt.update({'status':'DOWNLOADED_ORIGINAL_HTML','path':target.relative_to(root).as_posix(),'bytes':len(raw),'sha256':hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest(),'received_at':datetime.now(ZoneInfo('Asia/Shanghai')).isoformat(),'content_type':r.headers.get('Content-Type')}); break
 except Exception as e: attempts.append({'attempt':attempt,'error_type':type(e).__name__,'error':str(e)[:220]})
receipt['attempts']=attempts; receipt.setdefault('status','FAILED_FIXED_SOURCE_REQUEST')
with (out/'source_receipts_stage2.json').open('x',encoding='utf-8') as h: json.dump([receipt],h,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2); h.write('\n')
all_receipts=json.loads((out/'source_receipts_stage1.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8-sig'))+[receipt]
assert len(all_receipts)==3 and len({r['url'] for r in all_receipts})==3
with (out/'source_receipts.json').open('x',encoding='utf-8') as h: json.dump(all_receipts,h,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2); h.write('\n')
print('2022原计划：'+receipt['status']+'；已用新原HTML数='+str(len(all_receipts)))
assert all(r['status']=='DOWNLOADED_ORIGINAL_HTML' for r in all_receipts)
